bio: Ciro’s embodies the soul of Antwerp and its ever buzzy, down-to-earth vibe and delicious nostalgic interior provide a glimpse of the city of yesteryear. The proudly patriotic lineup on the menu also seems to have stepped straight out of the 1960s. Start with haddock pâté, followed by a star-studded lineup of deluxe vol-au-vent, crispy calf’s brains or steak garnished with a sauce so good you’ll be licking the plate clean, finishing with a decadent dame blanche (vanilla ice cream smothered in hot dark chocolate). It was love at first bite - bookings recommended!...
